notes: Ideas beyond the first 10 shipped tools. Each day pick the first status=todo item, build a one-page client-side tool, mark done, and update the index hub.

items.title: Password Generator
items.blurb: Generate random passwords with length and character-set options.

items.title: SHA-256 / MD5 Hash Generator
items.blurb: Hash text with Web Crypto (SHA-256) and a simple MD5 fallback note.

items.title: URL Encode / Decode
items.blurb: encodeURIComponent and decode for query strings.

items.title: HTML Entity Encoder
items.blurb: Escape and unescape HTML entities in text.

items.title: Markdown to HTML Preview
items.blurb: Lightweight markdown subset renderer in the browser.

items.title: HEX / RGB / HSL Color Converter
items.blurb: Convert between HEX, RGB, and HSL with a color swatch.

items.title: Length Unit Converter
items.blurb: Convert cm, inches, feet, meters, and miles.

items.title: Percentage Calculator
items.blurb: What is X% of Y, percent change, and reverse percentage.

items.title: Reading Time Calculator
items.blurb: Estimate reading time from word count at adjustable WPM.

items.title: Text Diff Checker
items.blurb: Side-by-side line diff for two text blocks.

items.title: CSV to JSON Converter
items.blurb: Parse CSV in-browser and output JSON array.

items.title: JSON to CSV Converter
items.blurb: Flatten a JSON array of objects into CSV.

items.title: Regex Tester
items.blurb: Test JavaScript regex with match highlighting.

items.title: Cron Expression Explainer
items.blurb: Human-readable description of a 5-field cron string.

items.title: QR Code Generator
items.blurb: Generate QR codes client-side (embed a tiny QR lib or canvas).

items.title: Meta Tag Preview
items.blurb: Preview title/description length for SERP and social cards.

items.title: Robots.txt Tester
items.blurb: Check if a path would be allowed by pasted robots.txt rules.

items.title: JWT Decoder
items.blurb: Decode JWT header and payload (no signature verification).

items.title: Number to Words
items.blurb: Convert integers to English words.

items.title: Text to ASCII Banner
items.blurb: Simple FIGlet-style uppercase banner from text.
